name: ts-test-impact
description: See inside your TypeScript, JavaScript and React code, offline and without AI. Flowcharts, data flow, why a value is what it is, null checks, affected tests, safe refactorings, inspections and search by shape, with plain names and a few surprises. Chart animations adapted from robot-components (MIT).

Run again on save on or off

viewsWelcome.contents:
Results of analyses appear here. Pick an action in the Actions view above, or put the cursor on a symbol and right-click in the editor.
[$(list-tree) Analyze or Refactor This…](command:tsStructure.actionsAtCursor)
Shortcuts: Ctrl+Alt+S then a letter (D Data Flow, U Usages, I Inspect, N Nullability…). [Keyboard Shortcuts…](command:tsStructure.editKeybindings)

Place the cursor on a function, class, method or symbol and run the analysis.
[$(beaker) Test Impact Analysis](command:tsImpact.analyze)

framework.description: Test framework used to run the impacted tests.

tsStructure.include.markdownDescription: Glob patterns, relative to the workspace folder, for the only files that inspections, Inspect Code, structural search, duplicate detection, mutation tracking, the type assertion audit and dead export results look at (for example `src/**`). A folder such as `src/app` includes everything below it. When empty, every file in the compiler project is included. `#tsStructure.exclude#` is applied after this.

tsStructure.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns, relative to the workspace folder, for files left out of inspections, Inspect Code, structural search, duplicate detection, mutation tracking, the type assertion audit and dead export results (for example `**/generated/**` or `src/legacy/*.ts`). A folder such as `src/legacy` excludes everything below it. Right-click files or folders in the Explorer and choose **Exclude from Code X-Ray Analysis** to add them.

tsStructure.askForScope.markdownDescription: Ask where to look (whole project, a folder, open editors, changed files, the current file, function or selection) before analyses that cover many files: Inspect Code, Find Duplicates, Dead Exports, Audit Type Assertions and Mutation Tracking in Project. The last choice is offered first. Turn off to always analyze the whole project.

tsStructure.features.testImpact.markdownDescription: **Test Impact Analysis**: Find and run the tests that depend on a symbol or file, and the Impacted Tests view. On by default; turn off to hide its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.refactorings.markdownDescription: **Refactorings**: Change Signature, Safe Delete, Introduce Parameter and Move Members, with their lightbulb entries. On by default; turn off to hide its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.intentions.markdownDescription: **Intention Actions**: Small rewrites in the lightbulb menu, such as flipping an if or converting to a template string. On by default; turn off to hide its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.inspections.markdownDescription: **Inspections**: Live inspections in the Problems panel, Inspect Code and Audit Type Assertions. On by default; turn off to hide its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.dataFlow.markdownDescription: **Data Flow and Mutation Tracking**: Data Flow Path Explorer and Mutation Tracking. On by default; turn off to hide its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.nullability.markdownDescription: **Nullability Path Explorer**: Nullability Path Explorer and the "Explain why this may be undefined" action on TypeScript errors. On by default; turn off to hide its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.usages.markdownDescription: **Semantic Find Usages**: References grouped by reads, writes, calls, imports, types and JSX. On by default; turn off to hide its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.sideEffects.markdownDescription: **Side-Effect Analyzer**: Side-Effect Analyzer and its CodeLens. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.promiseRejections.markdownDescription: **Promise Rejection Analyzer**: Where a function’s promise rejections are handled or lost. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.deadExports.markdownDescription: **Dead Export Analyzer**: Exports and files nothing reachable from the entry points uses. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.exceptionFlow.markdownDescription: **Exception Flow Visualizer**: Where errors are thrown, caught, transformed or swallowed. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.duplicates.markdownDescription: **Structural Duplicates**: Find code copied with renamed variables or changed values. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.reexports.markdownDescription: **Re-export Chain Navigator**: Follow a name through aliases and barrel files. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.structuralSearch.markdownDescription: **Structural Search and Replace**: Search and replace code by shape, and build custom inspections. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.hierarchy.markdownDescription: **Inheritance Hierarchy and Override Impact**: Supertypes, subtypes and overrides, and what a change to a member reaches. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.dependencyPath.markdownDescription: **Dependency Path Finder**: Why one module depends on another. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.graphDiff.markdownDescription: **Dependency Graph Diff**: How imports changed since a Git revision. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.features.argumentFlow.markdownDescription: **Argument Propagation Explorer**: Where a parameter’s values come from and where they go. Optional, off by default: turn on to add its commands and menus. **Code X-Ray: Choose Features…** changes several at once.

tsStructure.previewRefactorings.description: Show VS Code's Refactor Preview before applying refactorings, so individual changes can be reviewed and unticked.

tsStructure.highlightResults.description: Highlight the locations of the current analysis in open editors: definitions outlined, writes and reads shaded.

tsStructure.results.focusView.markdownDescription: Reveal the Code X-Ray view when an analysis finishes. Turn off to stay where you are; a status bar message says when a report is ready.

tsStructure.results.historySize.markdownDescription: How many reports **Previous Analysis** and **Next Analysis** keep.

tsStructure.results.rerunOnSave.markdownDescription: Re-run the report in the Code X-Ray view when you save a file it covers, instead of showing the *Files changed* banner.

tsStructure.lightbulbAnalyses.markdownDescription: Offer analyses in the lightbulb menu on a declaration name, such as **Show data flow of 'total'** on a variable or **Show side effects of f()** on a function. Only analyses whose feature is on are offered.

tsStructure.editorTitleButton.markdownDescription: Show the Code X-Ray button in the editor title bar of TypeScript and JavaScript files. It opens **Analyze or Refactor This…**.

tsStructure.contextMenu.topLevel.markdownDescription: Show **Find Usages in Current File**, **Semantic Find Usages**, **Data Flow Path Explorer** and **Analyze or Refactor This…** directly in the editor's right-click menu, next to Go to Definition. Everything else stays under **Code X-Ray**.

enumDescriptions: A spinner in the status bar while an analysis runs.
A notification while an analysis runs.
tsStructure.results.progress.markdownDescription: Where analyses show that they are running. Inspect Code always uses a notification, so it can be cancelled.

tsStructure.results.followCursor.markdownDescription: Select the result row of the place under the editor's cursor, so the Code X-Ray view shows where you are in the results. Next and Previous Result continue from it.

tsStructure.dataFlow.designPatterns.markdownDescription: Show the **Design patterns** group at the end of the Data Flow report.

tsStructure.safeDelete.confirmUnused.markdownDescription: Ask before Safe Delete removes something nothing uses. Turn off to delete unused, unexported code straight away (Ctrl+Z still undoes it).

enumDescriptions: Every button in the title of the results view.
Only Back, Re-run, Filter, About and Clear; the rest move to the ... menu.
tsStructure.results.toolbar.markdownDescription: Which buttons the title of the **Code X-Ray** results view shows. You can also hide a single button by right-clicking the title bar.

tsStructure.dataFlow.groupByDirection.markdownDescription: Data Flow: put the functions that write the value under **Flows in** and those that read it under **Flows out**, so each side collapses as one. Off: one group per function after Flows in and Flows out.

tsStructure.results.alwaysShowDiagram.markdownDescription: Show every new analysis as a diagram as soon as it is ready, as well as in the results view. The **Show as Diagram** button in the results view turns this on and off.

enumDescriptions: A pink bar and tint, easy to spot in any theme.
tsStructure.actions.accentColor.markdownDescription: The color that marks the action whose result is on screen in the **Actions** view (a raised row with a bar on its left, and a dot on its tab).

tsStructure.warmUp.markdownDescription: Prepare the project of the file you are editing in the background, a moment after you stop typing, so the first analysis starts at once. Turn off on very large projects if the editor feels slow right after opening a file.

tsStructure.inspections.enabled.description: Run the Code X-Ray inspections on open files and report findings in the Problems panel.

tsStructure.inspections.statusBar.description: Show the number of inspection findings in the active file in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Inspect while you type, after a short pause.
Inspect only when the file is saved. Faster on big projects.
tsStructure.inspections.run.markdownDescription: When live inspections run on an open file. Files are always inspected when they are opened.

tsStructure.inspections.delay.markdownDescription: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before inspecting, when `#tsStructure.inspections.run#` is `type`. Raise it if typing feels slow in a big project.

tsStructure.inspections.severity.markdownDescription: Severity per inspection, or `off` to disable it. `default` keeps the severity each finding is reported with. Findings can also be suppressed in code with `// ts-structure-ignore-next-line <id>` or `// ts-structure-ignore-file <id>`. Add `"editor.codeActionsOnSave": { "source.fixAll.tsStructure": "explicit" }` to apply preferred fixes on save.

missingAwait.description: Promises that are dropped, including through wrapper functions and helpers.

typeAssertion.description: Type assertions that are unnecessary, widen silently, narrow without a runtime check, or bypass compatibility checks.

tsStructure.missingAwait.ignore.markdownDescription: Functions whose promises may be dropped on purpose, such as fire-and-forget logging. `track` matches `track()` and `analytics.track()`; `*` is a wildcard, as in `logger.*`. A call is also ignored when its promise comes from an ignored function through wrappers.

tsStructure.typeAssertion.ignoreTestFile.description: Don't report type assertions in test files, where mocks and fixtures often need them.

tsStructure.customInspections.markdownDescription: Structural search patterns that run as live inspections. Create them with **Structural Search… → Save as Inspection** and manage them with **Manage Custom Inspections…**.

id.description: Unique id, shown as the diagnostic code custom:<id>.

type.description: Regular expression tested against the matched type.

text.description: Regular expression tested against the matched text.

message.description: Message for each match; $name$ is filled in from the match.

replacement.description: Quick fix template using the pattern placeholders.

files.description: Regular expression tested against file paths; only matching files are inspected.

tsStructure.intentions.disabled.markdownDescription: Intention actions to hide from the lightbulb menu. **Code X-Ray: Choose Intention Actions…** sets this from a checklist.

tsImpact.maxDepth.description: Maximum number of caller hops followed from the selected symbol.

tsImpact.includeInheritedMembers.description: Also follow calls made through interfaces and base classes that a selected class member implements or overrides. These matches are reported as possible impacts.

tsStructure.deadExports.entryPoints.markdownDescription: Glob patterns, relative to the workspace folder, for the files whose exports are the public API (for example `src/index.ts` or `src/pages/**`). When empty, entry points are read from package.json (`main`, `module`, `exports`, `bin`) and conventional `index`/`main` files.

tsStructure.deadExports.testFilesAreEntr.description: Treat test files as entry points, so exports used only by tests are not reported as dead.

tsStructure.duplicates.minStatements.description: Shortest run of consecutive statements compared by the structural duplicate finder.

tsStructure.duplicates.minTokens.description: Smallest duplicated fragment, in syntax nodes, that is reported.

tsStructure.duplicates.matchRenamedPrope.markdownDescription: Also report copies that use different property or method names, such as `item.price` in one copy and `parcel.weight` in the other. Finds more near-duplicates, with more noise.

tsStructure.duplicates.ignoreTestFiles.description: Leave test files out of project-wide duplicate searches.

tsStructure.argumentFlow.maxDepth.description: How many calls the Argument Propagation Explorer follows in each direction.

tsStructure.callGraph.depth.description: How many levels of callers and callees the Call Graph shows on each side.

tsStructure.codeLens.sideEffects.description: Show a CodeLens above each function summarizing its side effects ("pure", "mutates arguments · I/O", …). Click it for the full Side-Effect Analyzer report.

tsStructure.codeLens.sideEffectsShowPure.markdownDescription: Show the side-effect lens on pure functions too. Turn off to keep lenses only where a function has effects.

tsStructure.codeLens.sideEffectsIgnoreTe.markdownDescription: Leave the side-effect lens out of test files, where mocks and setup make most functions impure.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Code X-Ray
walkthroughs.description: See inside your TypeScript and JavaScript code in eight short steps.

steps.title: One shortcut for everything
steps.description:
Put the cursor on a function, variable or class and press **Ctrl+Alt+Shift+T** (**Analyze or refactor this…**). Every analysis and refactoring that fits is listed.
[Analyze or refactor this…](command:tsStructure.actionsAtCursor)

steps.title: Everything from the keyboard
steps.description:
**Ctrl+Alt+S** (**Cmd+Ctrl+S** on macOS), then a letter: **D** data flow, **U** find usages, **1** flowchart. Not sure which one? Ask the rubber duck.
[Cheat codes](command:tsStructure.shortcutSheet)
[Ask the rubber duck…](command:tsStructure.howDoI)

steps.title: Refactor across files
steps.description:
**Change parameters…** (**Ctrl+F6**) renames, adds, removes or reorders parameters and updates every call. **Delete safely** (**Alt+Delete**) checks every usage first.
[Change parameters…](command:tsStructure.changeSignature)

steps.title: Catch problems as you type
steps.description:
Live inspections find what linters miss, such as a promise dropped through a helper. Press **Ctrl+.** on a finding for its fixes.
[Inspect code…](command:tsStructure.inspectCode)

steps.title: Understand code before changing it
steps.description:
**Find usages** (**Alt+F7**) groups reads, writes and calls. **Data flow** and the **Charts** tab draw how values and calls move.
[Find usages](command:tsStructure.semanticUsages)
[Open a chart…](command:tsStructure.openGraph)

steps.title: Run only the tests a change affects
steps.description:
With the cursor on a function, **Affected tests** finds the tests that reach it, through other functions too, and runs only those.
[Affected tests](command:tsImpact.analyze)

steps.title: Open the toolshed
steps.description:
More tools start off to keep menus short: side effects, ghost exports, déjà vu for copied code, search by shape and more. Tick the ones you want.
[Toolshed…](command:tsStructure.configureFeatures)

steps.title: Leave files out
steps.description:
Leave generated or vendored code out: right-click a folder and choose **Leave out of Code X-Ray**, or say what to analyze.
[What to analyze…](command:tsStructure.editAnalysisScope)
[Settings](command:tsStructure.openSettings)
